# EMPLOYMENT OFFER LETTER — SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER

[Company Letterhead]

Date: [DATE]

[Candidate Name]
[Address]
[City, State ZIP]

Dear [Candidate Name],

We are pleased to extend an offer of employment for the position of **Senior Software Engineer** at [Company Name]. We believe your skills and experience will be a valuable addition to our engineering team.

## Position Details

**Title:** Senior Software Engineer
**Department:** Engineering
**Reports To:** [Engineering Manager Name/Title]
**Location:** [Office Location / Remote]
**Start Date:** [Proposed Start Date]
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Exempt
**Work Authorization:** You must be legally authorized to work in [Country] without sponsorship [or: sponsorship available, if applicable]

## Job Responsibilities (Summary)

In this role, you will:
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable software systems using [tech stack, e.g., Python, Java, React]
- Lead technical design reviews and mentor junior and mid-level engineers
- Collaborate with product, design, and infrastructure teams on feature delivery
- Participate in code reviews, on-call rotations, and agile ceremonies
- Contribute to architecture decisions and engineering best practices

A full job description is attached for reference.

## Compensation

**Base Salary:** $[AMOUNT] per year, paid [bi-weekly/semi-monthly/monthly], subject to applicable withholdings and deductions.

**Bonus:** Eligible for an annual discretionary performance bonus of up to [X]% of base salary, based on company and individual performance. Bonus eligibility requires active employment on the payment date and is at the Company's sole discretion.

**Equity:** Subject to Board approval and the Company's equity incentive plan, you will be granted [X] restricted stock units (RSUs) / stock options, vesting over [4] years with a [1]-year cliff, under the terms of a separate equity award agreement.

## Benefits

You will be eligible for our standard benefits package, including:
- Health insurance (medical, dental, vision) effective [date]
- 401(k) with [X]% company match
- [X] days paid time off (PTO) per year
- [X] paid holidays
- [Remote work stipend / learning & development budget / other engineering-specific perks]

Full details will be provided during onboarding.

## Contingencies

This offer is contingent upon:
- Successful completion of a background check
- Verification of your right to work in [Country]
- Execution of required employment documents, including:
  - Confidentiality Agreement
  - Intellectual Property (IP) Assignment Agreement
  - [Non-Compete / Non-Solicitation Agreement, if applicable]

## At-Will Employment

Please note that employment with [Company Name] is at-will. This means that either you or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice. This offer letter does not constitute a contract of employment for any specific period.

## Acceptance

To accept this offer, please sign below and return by [DEADLINE DATE]. This offer will expire if not accepted by that date.

We are excited about the possibility of you joining our team. If you have any questions, please contact [HR Contact] at [email/phone].

Sincerely,

_________________________
[Hiring Manager Name]
[Title]
[Company Name]

---

## ACCEPTANCE

I accept this offer of employment and agree to the terms stated above.

Signature: _________________________

Printed Name: _________________________

Date: _________________________

Anticipated Start Date: _________________________

---

- **Placeholders** in brackets `[ ]` should be replaced with your company's actual details — salary, vesting schedule, dates, and names.
- **Engineering-specific language** (mentoring, design reviews, on-call, tech stack) is included; adjust to match your actual job requirements.
- **Equity section** assumes RSUs/options — remove or adjust if not applicable.
- **Legal review:** Per the skill's best practices, have qualified legal counsel review before sending, since employment law varies by jurisdiction (e.g., non-compete enforceability, at-will requirements).
